headline: Situational Awareness is pitching a Fluidstack round at roughly double its valuation
body: Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund is pitching clients to invest alongside it in a Fluidstack round that would value the neocloud at $40 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter. The fund is raising money from its investors three months after highly levered AI bets nearly led to its implosion.
note: For finance readers, the structure matters: co-investments let clients buy into one deal alongside the manager. The $40 billion figure comes from a person familiar with the matter.

evidence.text: Situational Awareness is raising money from its investors to plow into neocloud startup Fluidstack Ltd. , just three months after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund’s implosion.
Leopold Aschenbrenner ’s fund is pitching clients to invest alongside it in a fundraising round that would value Fluidstack at $40 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter.
That’s roughly double the valuation the startup fetched mere months ago.
Co-investments let clients put money into specific deals alongside a firm rather than inside their fund.
